resolved.title: 算术运算符

content.text:
这个名字可能有点让人摸不着头脑。但是，**算术运算符**的功能主要是对数字（包括字面数字和变量）执行数学运算。

换句话说，算术运算符用于执行基本的数学运算，如加、减、乘、除、求余等。常见的算术运算符包括加号（`+`）、减号（`-`）、乘号（`*`）、除号（`/`）和求余号（`%`）

|运算符|描述|举例|
|----|----|----|
|+|加法|25 + 5 = 30|
|-|减法|25 - 5 = 20|
|*|乘法|10 * 20 = 200|
|/|除法|20 / 2 = 10|
|%|取余|56 % 3 = 2|
|++|自增|var a = 10; a++; 现在a = 11|
|--|自减|var a = 10; a--; 现在a = 9|
content.text_html:
The name might be a bit of a giveaway but, Arithmetic operators pretty much perform arithmetic functions on numbers (both literals and variables).

这个名字可能有点让人摸不着头脑，但是，算术运算符几乎是对数字（包括字面数字和变量）执行算术功能。

resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The Modulus[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 
Time to talk remainders. You hated them in school, but they’re pretty easy here, promise.

The [b]Modulus (%) operator[/b] returns the division remainder (what’s left over). 

[s0l0!-header][b]Like this:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="js" codeId="655"]var myVariable = 26 % 6;
[/code]
Because you’re left with a remainder of 2 when you divide 26 by 6.
[note][b]Heads up! [/b]
In JavaScript, we can use the modulus operator on integers AND on floating point numbers.[/note]

resolved.title: 自增运算 & 自减运算
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Increment & Decrement[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 
"Wait I've heard of an increment, but what the heck is a decrement?" We hear some of you say. Well, throw an increment into reverse and presto, you got yourself a decrement. Let’s dig a little deeper...

[b][u]Increment ++[/u][/b]
The increment operator [b]increases[/b] the numeric value of its operand [b]by 1[/b]. When placed before the operand, it’ll return the incremented value. When placed after it, it’ll return the original value and then increments the operand.

[b][u]Decrement --[/u][/b]
The decrement operator [b]decreases[/b] the numeric value of its operand [b]by 1[/b]. When placed before the operand, it’ll return the decremented value. When placed after the operand, it’ll return the original value and then decrements the operand. 

[s0l0!-header][b]Some examples:[/b][/s0l0!-header][img id="2746" width="100%"]
[note][b]Heads up![/b]
Just like the math you learned in school, you can change the order of the arithmetic operations by using parentheses.
Like this: var x = (100 + 50) * 3;[/note]

content.text:
**自增运算 ++** 自增运算符将其操作数的数值**增加1**。当放在操作数之前时，它将返回增加的值。当放在它后面时，它将返回原始值，然后增加操作数。 **自减运算 --** 自减运算符**递减**其操作数的数值，**递减1**。当放在操作数之前时，它将返回减去的值。当放在操作数后面时，它将返回原始值，然后再递减操作数。 如下面表格中的例子所示： |运算|描述|代码|结果| |----|----|----|----| |var++|先赋值后自增|
var a = 0, b = 10;
var a = b++;

|a = 10, b = 11| |++var|先自增再赋值|
var a = 0, b = 10;
var a = ++b;

|a = 11, b = 11| |var-\-|先赋值后递减|
var a = 0, b = 10;
var a = b--;

|a = 10, b = 9| |-\-var|先自减再赋值|
var a = 0, b = 10;
var a = --b;

|a = 9, b = 9|
content.text_html:
"Wait I've heard of an increment, but what the heck is a decrement?" We hear some of you say. Well, throw an increment into reverse and presto, you got yourself a decrement. Let’s dig a little deeper...

Increment ++ The increment operator increases the numeric value of its operand by 1. When placed before the operand, it’ll return the incremented value. When placed after it, it’ll return the original value and then increments the operand.

Decrement -- The decrement operator decreases the numeric value of its operand by 1. When placed before the operand, it’ll return the decremented value. When placed after the operand, it’ll return the original value and then decrements the operand.

"等等，我听说过增量，但减量是什么鬼东西？"我们听到你们中的一些人说。好吧，把增量抛向反向，你就得到了一个减量。让我们再深入了解一下...

增量 ++ 增量运算符将其操作数的数值增加1。当放在操作数之前时，它将返回增加的值。当放在它后面时，它将返回原始值，然后增加操作数。

递减 -- 递减运算符递减其操作数的数值，递减1。当放在操作数之前时，它将返回减去的值。当放在操作数后面时，它将返回原始值，然后再递减操作数。
